sourceText: User clarified: remove dollar amount as a limiting condition. The goal is to complete the validation task, then compute and compare actual provider spend after completion; do not make a guessed amount a pre-run condition.
normalizedOutcome: Cell 03 provider execution readiness no longer requires a pre-run dollar amount. It is controlled by a frozen execution envelope, and actual provider-reported usage/cost is recorded after execution.
acceptanceClaim: The M2 provider execution checker reports Cell 03 execution envelope frozen, pre-run dollar guess not required, provider calls disabled in this authorization story, postflight provider-reported usage required after execution, and Cell 06 A2prime still blocked.
